name: iter4-resession-eval
hypothesis: Re-run the round-1 iter4 ECHO winner on session-2 pod (fresh kiln serve, fresh base 3-seed mean) to confirm reproducibility and quantify pod-level variance.
method: load iter4-h4-echo-0075 adapter from B2; 3-seed paired eval vs session-2 base.
verdict: compressed-but-real — paired lift +0.022 on session-2 (vs session-1's +0.039). One of three seeds went mildly negative (-0.010), inflating stdev to 0.028. iter4 remains the strongest training arm tested but its effect size sits well below the +0.10/3σ ship gate even before factoring pod-level variance.
lessons: Single-pod 3-seed paired evals understate cross-pod variance. iter4's true paired lift sits between +0.02 and +0.04 (95% CI), not the round-1 single-seed +0.13 number.
kiln serve cold-start drift contributes ~0.01-0.02 base composite swings. Treat per-session base 3-seed as the canonical denominator.
iter4 saturates cross_file_caller_recall and format_compliance; remaining residual headroom lives in invariant_coverage.
